title: Townsend Brown and the Nassau Group

tellings.quote: Towns and Brown also spent a ton of time in Nassau. In fact, his biographer Paul Shatskin even coined a term for a secret group that used to meet there. It was called the Nassau Group

plain: The American inventor Thomas Townsend Brown is said to have spent a great deal of time in Nassau, in the Bahamas, where a secret group used to meet. Michels tells this himself, drawing on Brown's biographer Paul Schatzkin, author of the biography The Man Who Mastered Gravity, who Michels says coined a name for that circle: "the Nassau Group." Michels does not say who belonged to it or what it did.
